claims: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. children under 18.
Trump Accounts were created by the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act".
Children born between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2028, receive a $1,000 government seed deposit.
Parents can open Trump Accounts via IRS Form 4547 or at TrumpAccounts.gov.
5 million Trump Accounts are already registered as of April 2026.
Trump Accounts include a $1,000 pilot contribution for 2025–2028 births.
Parents, relatives, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 annually to Trump Accounts.
Funds in Trump Accounts are invested in ETFs/mutual funds.
Funds in Trump Accounts typically track the S&P 500.
Funds in Trump Accounts grow tax-deferred.
Funds in Trump Accounts are locked until the child turns 18.
Trump Accounts convert to a traditional IRA at age 18.
Children must have a Social Security number for Trump Account eligibility.
Trump Accounts can be established on TrumpAccounts.gov or by filing IRS Form 4547.
Contributions to Trump Accounts begin July 4, 2026.
